name: commerce.SalesOrder
description: An order placed by a customer. 1:N link to crm.Customer with the inverse role `orders`; implements commerce.Order by narrowing the required link's target from party.Party to crm.Customer; backed by warehouse tables in the technical view.

links.description: Technical view (ruling 2026-09-25 section 18): the tables this business type is materialized from.

invariants.message: An order total cannot be negative.
